# Lab 12.21: Deploy Secure Web Proxy

## What We Are Going to Do
Deploy Secure Web Proxy as an explicit proxy so VMs can reach only approved websites.

## Steps

1. **Enable APIs and build the network.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud services enable networksecurity.googleapis.com networkservices.googleapis.com \
  certificatemanager.googleapis.com
gcloud compute networks create swp-vpc --subnet-mode=custom
gcloud compute networks subnets create swp-subnet --network=swp-vpc \
  --region=us-central1 --range=10.50.0.0/24
gcloud compute networks subnets create swp-proxy-only --network=swp-vpc \
  --region=us-central1 --range=192.168.0.0/23 \
  --purpose=REGIONAL_MANAGED_PROXY --role=ACTIVE</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


2. **Create a certificate for the proxy.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">openssl req -x509 -newkey rsa:2048 -nodes -days 30 \
  -keyout swp.key -out swp.crt -subj "/CN=swp.lab.internal"
gcloud certificate-manager certificates create swp-cert \
  --certificate-file=swp.crt --private-key-file=swp.key --location=us-central1</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


3. **Create the policy and an allow rule.** Create `policy.yaml` and `rule.yaml`:


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • YAML
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">name: projects/YOUR_PROJECT_ID/locations/us-central1/gatewaySecurityPolicies/lab-swp-policy
description: Lab policy</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • YAML
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">name: projects/YOUR_PROJECT_ID/locations/us-central1/gatewaySecurityPolicies/lab-swp-policy/rules/allow-google
description: Allow www.google.com only
enabled: true
priority: 1
basicProfile: ALLOW
sessionMatcher: host() == 'www.google.com'</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud network-security gateway-security-policies import lab-swp-policy \
  --source=policy.yaml --location=us-central1
gcloud network-security gateway-security-policies rules import allow-google \
  --source=rule.yaml --location=us-central1 --gateway-security-policy=lab-swp-policy</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


4. **Create the gateway.** Create `gateway.yaml`:


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • YAML
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">name: projects/YOUR_PROJECT_ID/locations/us-central1/gateways/lab-swp
type: SECURE_WEB_GATEWAY
addresses: ["10.50.0.10"]
ports: [443]
certificateUrls: ["projects/YOUR_PROJECT_ID/locations/us-central1/certificates/swp-cert"]
gatewaySecurityPolicy: projects/YOUR_PROJECT_ID/locations/us-central1/gatewaySecurityPolicies/lab-swp-policy
network: projects/YOUR_PROJECT_ID/global/networks/swp-vpc
subnetwork: projects/YOUR_PROJECT_ID/regions/us-central1/subnetworks/swp-subnet
scope: lab-scope</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud network-services gateways import lab-swp --source=gateway.yaml --location=us-central1</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


5. **Test from a private VM.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud compute firewall-rules create swp-iap --network=swp-vpc --allow=tcp:22 --source-ranges=35.235.240.0/20
gcloud compute instances create swp-client --zone=us-central1-a --machine-type=e2-micro \
  --subnet=swp-subnet --no-address
gcloud compute ssh swp-client --zone=us-central1-a --tunnel-through-iap --command="\
  curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' -x https://10.50.0.10:443 --proxy-insecure https://www.google.com; \
  curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' -x https://10.50.0.10:443 --proxy-insecure https://example.com"</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   Google returns `200`. Example.com returns `403` from the proxy.

6. **Clean up.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud compute instances delete swp-client --zone=us-central1-a --quiet
gcloud network-services gateways delete lab-swp --location=us-central1 --quiet
gcloud network-security gateway-security-policies delete lab-swp-policy --location=us-central1 --quiet
gcloud certificate-manager certificates delete swp-cert --location=us-central1 --quiet</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   Then delete the firewall rule, subnets and `swp-vpc`.

## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| Allowed site | `200` through the proxy |
| Any other site | `403` from Secure Web Proxy |
| Rules | Written in CEL, for example `host()` |
| TLS inspection | Optional, needs a CA Service pool |
